b1-n-uebernachtung: At the hotel desk you ask how much it costs to sleep there for one night.
You book a bed at a hostel on your trip, for sleeping there from Friday to Saturday.
On the invoice there are two entries for sleeping at the guest house. Which word means 'overnight stay'?
b1-adv-quer: You cut the sandwich from one corner to the opposite corner, not straight down the middle.
A path leads straight over the field, from one side to the other.
You lay the book on the table so that it points crosswise to the edge. Which adverb means 'crosswise'?
b1-v-ziehen: The door has a sign for you to take the handle toward you and not push.
A horse draws a heavy cart along the road.
Next month your family leaves this flat to live in another town. Which verb means 'to move' house?
b1-n-pfingsten: In spring, fifty days after Easter, many Germans get two days off and families go on short trips.
A church festival in May or June remembers the Holy Spirit, and schools have a short break.
A calendar shows a Christian holiday fifty days after Easter. Which word means 'Pentecost'?
b1-n-katalog: A furniture company sends you a thick booklet with pictures of all its products and prices.
In the library, you search the list of all available books by author and title.
Before ordering, you browse a printed booklet of all the items on sale. Which word means 'catalogue'?
b1-adj-merkwuerdig: Your neighbour wears a winter coat in summer and talks to his plants. You find his behaviour a bit unusual.
There is a smell in the room that nobody can explain. Something feels odd.
A friend says the story does not sound normal at all. Which adjective means 'strange'?
b1-n-zufall: You meet an old school friend in a foreign city, with no plan. Nobody arranged it.
Two strangers on a train find out they have the same birthday. They laugh because nothing was planned.
It happened by pure luck and nobody planned it. Which word means 'chance'?
b1-v-schminken: Before the party, your sister stands at the mirror with lipstick and eye shadow.
An actor sits in the dressing room while an artist applies colour to his face before the show.
You want to cover your tired face with powder and mascara. Which verb means 'to put on make-up'?
b1-n-reihenfolge: In the queue, each person waits for their turn. Who is first, who is second?
The teacher wants the pupils to line up as A, B, C.
The recipe says to do the steps one after the other in the right way. Which word means 'order' or 'sequence'?
b1-n-mensa: At university you eat a cheap hot lunch with other students in a big hall on campus.
Your friend says: 'See you at twelve at the place where students get a cheap meal.'
The university has a big dining hall where students eat lunch. Which word means 'student canteen'?
b1-v-unterstuetzen: Your friend is moving house, and you come to carry boxes and give help.
A company gives money to a local football club to help it.
Your parents back you financially while you study. Which verb means 'to support'?
b1-adj-minimal: The difference between the two prices is very small, almost nothing.
The doctor says the danger is as small as it can possibly be.
The damage was tiny, the smallest possible. Which adjective means 'minimal'?
b1-n-wissenschaftler: A man in a laboratory studies cells under a microscope and publishes his results in journals.
At the university a man does research about the climate and writes scientific papers.
A man works to discover new facts about the universe. Which word means a male 'scientist'?
b1-n-beitrag: Every member of the sports club pays a fixed amount of money each month.
You write a text for the school magazine and see it printed on page five.
In the meeting everyone adds ideas to help the team. Which word means 'contribution'?
b1-v-atmen: After running you stop and take big gulps of air through your nose and mouth.
The doctor puts a stethoscope on your back and asks you to draw air in and push it out slowly.
A baby sleeps quietly, and you watch her chest go up and down. Which verb means 'to breathe'?
b1-n-sonderangebot: The supermarket sells coffee this week for half the normal price.
A shop window sign says the jackets are cheap only until Saturday.
A flyer shows a washing machine at a very low price for a limited time. Which word means 'special offer'?
b1-n-steward: On a flight, a man in uniform serves drinks and shows passengers the emergency exits.
On a cruise ship, a man in uniform takes care of the passengers and brings coffee.
A young man wants to work in the sky looking after passengers on planes. Which word means a male 'steward'?
b1-adj-treu: Your dog waits for you at the door every day and never leaves your side.
She has been with her husband for fifty years and has never cheated on him.
A friend stays by your side in good times and bad. Which adjective means 'loyal'?
b1-adv-vermutlich: Dark clouds are in the sky. You say it will rain, but you are not completely sure.
Your friend is not answering. You guess he is still sleeping.
The train is late, and you assume it will arrive soon, but you are not certain. Which adverb means 'probably'?
b1-n-gegner: In a tennis match, the man on the other side of the net tries to beat you.
In a chess game, you look at the man you are playing against.
In a debate, a man argues for the other side. Which word means a male 'opponent'?
b1-v-sich-entschliessen: After thinking for weeks, you finally make up your mind to move to Berlin.
You stand in front of two jackets and finally say: 'I will take the blue one.'
After a long talk, he made a firm choice to quit smoking. Which verb means 'to decide'?
b1-n-ernaehrung: A doctor advises you to eat more vegetables and less sugar for your health.
A school lesson teaches what kinds of food the body needs.
What we eat and drink each day matters for growth and health. Which word means 'nutrition'?
b1-n-erlebnis: Your first time on a roller coaster is something you will remember all your life.
After a trip, you tell your friends about something amazing that happened to you.
A diary entry describes a special event of the holiday. Which word means 'experience'?
b1-v-losfahren: Everyone is in the car with seat belts on. The driver turns the key and starts the journey.
The bus is full. The driver closes the doors and the trip begins.
Your friend says you should depart at six in the morning to avoid traffic. Which verb means 'to set off'?
b1-adj-eckig: The table is not round. It has four sharp corners.
You look at a box with edges and corners, not rounded at all.
The glasses have a frame that is not round but has corners. Which adjective means 'angular'?
b1-n-monitor: On your desk, a screen is connected to your computer and shows what you type.
At the hospital, a screen next to the bed shows the patient's heartbeat.
You buy a bigger screen for your PC. Which word means 'monitor'?
b1-n-forderung: The workers want ten percent more pay. They make this firm request to the boss.
A letter from a company says you owe them 200 euros and must pay.
At the demonstration they carry signs with their wishes. Which word means 'demand'?
b1-n-bar: In the evening you meet friends at a place with a long counter, dim light and cocktails.
A man behind a counter mixes drinks for guests at night.
In the hotel lobby there is a small place that sells alcoholic drinks. Which word means 'bar'?
b1-v-winken: At the station your friend's train leaves. You raise your hand and move it from side to side to say goodbye.
In a restaurant you raise your hand to call the waiter closer.
A child on a ship moves his hand toward the crowd on the shore. Which verb means 'to wave'?
b1-n-rundfahrt: In a new city you take a bus that shows you the main sights and brings you back to where it started.
A boat takes tourists along the river and back in two hours.
A guide offers a trip around the city for visitors. Which word means 'sightseeing tour'?
b1-adj-aergerlich: The train is late again. You are fed up and say it is irritating.
Your neighbour's loud music every night makes you annoyed.
The waiter forgot your order twice. Which adjective means 'annoying'?
b1-n-neuigkeit: Your friend phones and says: 'I have something new to tell you!' She got a job.
The newspaper reports fresh information from the town each morning.
A message tells you about a recent event. Which word means 'a piece of news'?
b1-v-frieren: It is minus ten outside and you have no jacket. You shiver and feel very cold.
In winter, the water on the lake turns to ice.
You put soup in the freezer and it turns solid. Which verb means 'to freeze'?
b1-n-bikini: At the beach she wears a two-piece swimsuit.
You pack for the holiday: sun cream, a towel and a two-piece swimming outfit.
A shop sells swimwear for women with only two small parts. Which word means 'bikini'?
b1-n-beratung: At the bank, a clerk sits with you to explain different savings plans and helps you choose.
You visit an office where an expert listens to your problems and gives guidance.
Before buying a laptop, you ask the shop assistant for help in choosing. Which word means 'advice'?
b1-adv-moeglichst: Your boss says: 'Please finish this task as quickly as you can.' Which small word means 'as ... as possible'?
The teacher says: 'Write as many words as you can.' Which word means 'as ... as possible'?
You ask the travel agent for a hotel with a pool, if it can be done. Which adverb means 'preferably'?
b1-v-reinigen: You wipe the windows with a cloth and liquid until there are no spots.
A dental assistant makes your teeth free from plaque.
A cleaner scrubs the floor of the office every evening. Which verb means 'to clean'?
b1-n-spezial: In a shop, there is a knife made for one purpose only, like cutting bread. Which word part at the start of such compound nouns means 'special'?
A restaurant offers a menu made only for this week. The first part of the word means 'special'. Which word part is it?
A TV channel has a show about one single topic. Which short word part at the beginning of the word means 'special'?
b1-adj-passiv: At the meeting your colleague sits quietly and never joins in. He does not do anything himself.
A friend never starts anything. He just waits and lets things happen to him.
A person only watches and never takes part in the activity. Which adjective means 'passive'?
b1-n-bargeld: At the market stall there is no card machine. You must pay with coins and notes.
At the cash machine you take out money that you can hold in your hand.
The sign says: 'We accept only money in notes and coins.' Which word means 'cash'?
b1-n-angehoerige: After the accident, the hospital calls a man who is a family member of the patient.
At a family meeting, a man who belongs to the same family as the sick woman answers the doctor's questions.
The form asks for a contact person from your family circle. Which word means a male 'relative'?
b1-v-annehmen: A friend gives you a present. You take it and say thank you.
You see the lights are off, so you suppose that nobody is home.
A company offers you a job and you say yes. Which verb means 'to accept'?
b1-n-zeuge: A man saw the car accident happen and tells the police what he saw.
In court, a man stands up to say what he saw on the night of the crime.
The police look for someone who saw the event and can tell about it. Which word means a male 'witness'?
b1-adj-wuetend: Your brother broke your phone on purpose. You shout and your face turns red.
A customer slams his fist on the counter because the shop lost his order.
She was so angry that she could not speak. Which adjective means 'furious'?
b1-n-bankleitzahl: On a transfer form, besides your account number, you must write the number that identifies the bank.
The online form asks for an eight-digit number for the bank's branch.
To send money inside Germany, you need a number for the bank itself. Which word means 'bank code'?
b1-v-verursachen: A driver does not see the red light and brings about a crash.
Heavy rain is the reason for the flooding in the town.
Too much sugar can lead to bad teeth. Which verb means 'to cause'?
b1-n-klick: You press the mouse button once on a link on the screen.
A camera makes a small sharp noise when you press the shutter.
With only one press of the mouse, you order the product online. Which word means 'click'?
b1-n-bereich: Your friend works in the field of marketing, not in sales.
A sign says this part of the building is for staff only.
In which part of science are you interested? Which word means 'area' or 'field'?
b1-n-moeglichkeit: You have three ways to pay: cash, card or bank transfer.
Maybe it will rain tomorrow, or maybe not. There is a chance it could happen.
A friend says there is a chance to study abroad next year. Which word means 'opportunity' or 'possibility'?
b1-v-verschmutzen: The factory pours waste into the river and makes the water dirty.
Your child plays in mud and gets his white shirt dirty.
Cars with old engines put harmful stuff into the air. Which verb means 'to pollute'?
b1-adj-blind: A man cannot see anything. He walks with a white stick, and a dog helps him.
In the library a book has dots that you read with your fingers, for people who cannot see.
She lost her sight as a child. Which adjective means 'blind'?
b1-n-sportler: A man trains six days a week, runs, lifts weights and competes in races.
At the Olympic Games, men from many countries compete in different events.
A man does sport regularly, perhaps in a club. Which word means a male 'athlete'?
b1-adv-gemeinsam: You and your friends cook dinner at the same time, all of you doing it as a group.
Two companies share the costs and run the project jointly.
You and your sister go on holiday, both of you, not alone. Which adverb means 'together'?
b1-n-kreuz: Two lines, one vertical and one horizontal, meet in the middle. It is a shape on top of a church.
On a map, you mark the place with a small sign shaped like an x.
In a church you see a shape made of two beams hanging on the wall. Which word means 'cross'?
b1-v-beschaedigen: You hit a pole while parking and the bumper is scratched.
The storm broke a few tiles on the roof.
The parcel arrived with a torn corner. Which verb means 'to damage'?
b1-n-einbrecher: A man climbs through a window at night to steal things from a house.
The police look for a man who broke into three shops last week.
A man forced the lock on your door while you were away. Which word means 'burglar'?
b1-n-biene: In the garden a small striped insect collects pollen from flowers and makes honey.
Beekeepers look after hives where thousands of these insects live.
A small insect buzzes and can sting, and it gives you honey. Which word means 'bee'?
b1-adj-stilistisch: A critic talks about the way the author chooses words and builds sentences.
An architect compares the design features of two buildings, like their shape and decoration.
A teacher says there is a problem in how the essay is written, not in the facts. Which adjective means 'stylistic'?
b1-v-sich-konzentrieren: It is noisy in the library, but you try to keep your mind only on your book.
Before the exam, you put your phone away so that nothing distracts you.
The teacher asks you to fix your attention on the task. Which verb means 'to concentrate'?
b1-n-detail: The police ask the witness for even the smallest pieces of information about the event.
A painter spends hours on the tiny parts of the picture.
You do not need the whole story, just one small point. Which word means 'detail'?
b1-n-roman: You read a long invented story of 400 pages about a family across three generations.
A writer spends years writing a long book of fiction.
At the bookshop, you ask for a thick book with an invented story, not a poem or a textbook. Which word means 'novel'?
b1-n-mitglied: You pay a small fee every year and have a card to enter the swimming club.
Ten people belong to the team, and you are one of them.
The library says you can borrow books for free if you join. Which word means 'member'?
b1-v-bloggen: Every week you write a text about your travels and post it on your website for readers.
She publishes recipes with photos on her own page online.
Your friend keeps an online diary for the public. Which verb means 'to blog'?
b1-adj-verantwortlich: The captain of the ship is the person who must answer for what happens on board.
A teacher asks who is in charge of the broken window.
You look after your little sister and must make sure she is safe. Which adjective means 'responsible'?
b1-n-recht: Every person is allowed to say what he thinks. It is a freedom nobody can take away.
A student studies the rules the state makes to govern society.
You are entitled to 25 days of holiday. Which word means 'right'?
b1-n-hof: The apartment building has a small open space behind it where children play and bikes stand.
The farmer lives on his land with cows, chickens and a barn.
The castle has a big open square surrounded by walls. Which word means 'courtyard'?
b1-v-begruessen: Guests arrive at your house. You stand at the door, smile and say hello to each of them.
The mayor opens the event and says a few friendly words to the visitors.
The teacher says good morning to the class as they enter. Which verb means 'to greet'?
b1-n-zeichnung: In art class, you make a picture with a pencil on paper.
The architect shows a rough picture of the building before the final plans.
A child gives her mother a picture she made with crayons. Which word means 'drawing'?
b1-adv-nochmals: You did not understand the teacher. You ask her to say it one more time.
The first try failed, so you try one more time.
The song is so good that you listen to it again. Which adverb means 'once more'?
b1-n-unternehmer: A man started his own company with five employees and runs it himself.
A man has an idea for a business, takes the risk and creates jobs for others.
The man who owns the firm pays wages to the workers. Which word means a male 'entrepreneur'?
b1-adj-ausreichend: You have enough food in the fridge for the whole weekend, so there is no need to shop.
The teacher says the answers are just enough to pass, with a grade of 4.
Is the light in this room enough to read by? Which adjective means 'sufficient'?
b1-n-kloss: At a German restaurant, the roast comes with a round ball made from potato dough, served with gravy.
Grandma boils round balls of potato dough in water.
Round potato balls boiled in water are a typical side dish. Which word means 'dumpling'?
b1-v-transportieren: A truck carries goods from the harbour to the warehouse.
The ambulance brings the injured man to the hospital.
The company moves heavy machines by ship. Which verb means 'to transport'?
b1-n-grenze: You drive from one country to another and officers check passports at the line between them.
A fence marks where your garden ends and your neighbour's begins.
Tourists cross the line between two countries. Which word means 'border'?
b1-n-mieter: A man pays 600 euros every month to live in a flat that he does not own.
The landlord sends a letter to the man who lives in the flat about the rent increase.
A man signs a contract to live in a flat and pays rent. Which word means a male 'tenant'?
b1-v-feststehen: The date of the wedding is already decided: 12 June. Nothing will change.
The boss says it is now clear that the meeting takes place on Monday.
Everything is already settled and cannot be changed. Which verb means 'to be fixed'?
b1-adj-urspruenglich: At first, the plan was to travel by train, but we changed it. How do you describe the plan from the start?
The old church still has its first form, and nothing has been changed.
The forest is untouched by people, wild and natural. Which adjective means 'original' or 'unspoiled'?
b1-n-erkaeltung: You have a runny nose, a cough and a sore throat, and you stay in bed for three days.
In winter, many people sneeze and feel weak because of a mild illness.
You tell your boss you cannot come in because you have caught a mild illness with sneezing. Which word means 'a cold'?
b1-n-vorspeise: At the restaurant, before the main dish, you order a small soup.
The waiter asks what you would like to eat first, before the big dish.
On the menu: soup or salad, served before the main course. Which word means 'starter'?
b1-v-laecheln: You greet a stranger with a friendly face and a small curve of your lips, without laughing.
When the photographer asks for happy faces, the children show them.
A baby looks at her mother and shows a small happy expression. Which verb means 'to smile'?
b1-n-umfrage: A woman on the street asks you five questions about your shopping habits for a study.
The newspaper asked 1,000 people who their favourite singer is.
The school asks all students in a form about the canteen. Which word means 'survey'?
b1-n-pech: You arrive at the station just as your train leaves. What terrible luck!
It rained on the only day of your holiday when you wanted to go to the beach.
You have a flat tyre on the way to an important meeting. Which word means 'bad luck'?
b1-adj-zufaellig: You did not plan it. You met your teacher at the supermarket.
The glass fell down without anyone wanting it to.
You happened to find the key under the sofa. Which adjective means 'by chance'?
b1-n-einfall: While showering, you suddenly think of a clever solution for your project.
A child comes up with a funny plan to hide the vegetables.
In a brainstorm the team shares many quick thoughts. Which word means 'idea'?
b1-v-spueren: You touch a hot pan and notice the heat on your fingers.
In the room you notice that something is wrong. You can feel it.
Your skin senses the wind on your face. Which verb means 'to feel'?
b1-adv-halbtags: A mother works only four hours a day, mornings only.
A job ad says: 'We need someone for the morning only, not the full day.'
You do not work full-time but for half of the working day. Which adverb means 'part-time'?
b1-n-rolle: An actor plays a character in the new film.
In the shop, you buy a cylinder of toilet paper.
In a project every member has a task and a part to play. Which word means 'role'?
b1-n-zahnpasta: In the morning you squeeze a white paste onto your brush.
The dentist recommends a paste with fluoride for cleaning your teeth.
At the pharmacy you buy a tube for brushing your teeth. Which word means 'toothpaste'?
b1-v-umgehen: The road ahead is closed, so you take a different route around it.
A firm finds a trick to avoid paying taxes.
A child learns how to deal with a sharp knife safely. Which verb means 'to handle'?
b1-n-buerger: A man who lives in Germany and has a German passport belongs to the country with rights and duties.
The mayor invites the people of the city to a meeting. Every man who belongs to the state is welcome.
A man has the nationality of a country. Which word means a male 'citizen'?
b1-adj-gleichberechtigt: In a good marriage, the husband and wife have the same rights and decide things together.
At the company, women and men have the same chances and equal rights.
Everyone should have the same standing before the law. Which adjective means 'with equal rights'?
b1-n-personalie: At the hotel the receptionist asks for your name, date of birth and address.
On the application form, there is a section for your name, address and birthday.
The police officer asks to see your ID to check your name and address. Which word means 'personal details'?
b1-n-einfahrt: In front of the garage, there is a short paved road where the car goes in.
A sign at the front says 'Do not block' because it is the way into the courtyard for cars.
The sign at the car park says 'Entrance for vehicles'. Which word means 'driveway' or 'entry'?
b1-v-tippen: You write a message on the keyboard with your fingers.
You touch the screen of the phone lightly with a finger.
You guess the result of the football match, for example 2:1, in a betting game. Which verb means 'to tip'?
b1-n-ueberzeugung: He firmly believes in his opinion and nobody can change his mind.
In an interview, a man says that he lives as a vegetarian because of his strong belief.
After a long talk, you managed to make him agree with you. Which word means 'conviction'?
b1-adj-nahe: The bakery is only two minutes away from your flat.
The airport is close to the city centre.
Your friend lives not far from you. Which adjective means 'near'?
b1-n-kosten: Before you buy a car, you calculate petrol, insurance and repairs.
The bill for the repair shows the amount you have to pay for the work.
The bank asks about your monthly expenses. Which word means 'costs'?
b1-v-landen: The plane touches the runway and rolls to a stop.
The pilot says that we will be on the ground in ten minutes.
A bird comes down from the sky and sits on a branch. Which verb means 'to land'?
b1-n-nordsee: In summer, many German families go to the coast in the north and see the tides and islands like Sylt.
It is the sea to the north of Germany, between Britain and Denmark and Norway.
On the map of Europe you see the sea between Britain and Scandinavia. Which word is its name, 'the North Sea'?
b1-n-regal: In your living room there is a piece of furniture along the wall with many levels for books.
At the supermarket the goods stand on long boards in rows.
You put your books on a board attached to the wall. Which word means 'shelf'?
